description: This Java class 'PojoWrapper' represents a wrapper for POJO variables within a code generation or parsing framework. It manages dependencies on other wrappers such as enums, events, custom objects, and arrays, and provides methods to access variable information and dependencies.

classes.name: PojoWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for POJO variables that manages dependencies and variable information.

methods.name: PojoWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a CustomVariable and adds it to the POJO section.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Returns the name of the variable represented by this POJO wrapper.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dependencies of this POJO wrapper.

methods.name: buildDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes the custom variable to identify and build dependencies on other wrappers.

methods.name: checkDependency
methods.description: Checks the type of a variable and adds appropriate dependencies (enum, event, custom, array).

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Adds a wrapper to dependencies and updates language settings.
